Interface CallbackProxy

All Superinterfaces:
Callback
public interface CallbackProxy extends Callback
Placeholder proxy interface to allow an InvocationHandler to convert arguments/return values on callback methods. This is a special sub-interface of Callback which expects its arguments in a single Object array passed to its callback(Object[]) method.
